rephrasedPassages.before: Prediction — An expected observation under stated conditions.
rephrasedPassages.after: Prediction — What you expect to observe under stated conditions.

rephrasedPassages.before: Evidence — Information used to judge an idea or answer a question.
rephrasedPassages.after: Evidence — Information for judging an idea or answering a question.

rephrasedPassages.before: Fair comparison — A comparison that keeps other relevant conditions alike while testing a particular difference.
rephrasedPassages.after: Fair comparison — A comparison in which one difference is tested while other relevant conditions stay the same.

rephrasedPassages.before: Assumption — Something accepted for the moment without having checked it.
rephrasedPassages.after: Assumption — Something taken to be true for now, although it has not been checked.

rephrasedPassages.before: Evaporation — The change of liquid water into water vapour at its surface.
rephrasedPassages.after: Evaporation — The change from liquid water to water vapour at the surface.

rephrasedPassages.before: Condensation — The change of water vapour into liquid water.
rephrasedPassages.after: Condensation — The formation of liquid water from water vapour.
